_comment: TEMPORAL-EXTRAPOLATION EXPERIMENT, run 1975. Withholds 1966-1975 (10 years) from the DESK objective entirely, so those years test extrapolation BACKWARD beyond the training data -- the direction the 1900 use case needs. Run the three overlays (1975/1985/1995) to get skill against extrapolation distance. desk.trend.seed is NOT overridden anywhere: the spatial split must stay identical across the three or the decay curve is confounded by a moving holdout. Usage: ESK_DESK_CONFIG=config/overlays/desk_tempho_1975.json STAGES=desk bash scripts/tacc/submit_encoder.sh
